storefront: Fixed-scope software micro-services, AI-operated with deterministic validation
disclosure: Services are fulfilled with AI assistance, automated quality validation, and human review. No hidden AI use. Payment is handled only through the linked Contra service pages; this site sells nothing directly and handles no payment data.

payment.note: Order and pay only through the order_url Contra service page. Work starts after the marketplace confirms the order. No direct transfers, invoices, or crypto addresses are offered on this site.

services.name: OpenAPI 3.1 documentation from your code or endpoints
services.scope: Up to 15 endpoints. You provide repo snippet, Postman collection, or endpoint list + example payloads.
services.validation: Spectral lint passes; every documented endpoint matches a provided source endpoint.

services.name: Single-file Python automation script
services.scope: One clearly-scoped task (file processing, API glue, scraping public data, report generation). Stdlib + up to 3 pip deps.
services.validation: pytest passes; script runs clean on provided sample input.

services.name: Code review report (up to 500 LOC)
services.scope: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Go. You provide a repo link or files.
services.validation: Every finding cites an exact file:line that exists in the submitted code.

services.name: JSON/CSV/XLSX data conversion & cleanup
services.scope: Up to 50k rows / 20 MB. Schema mapping, dedup, normalization, encoding fixes.
services.validation: Deterministic row-count and field-mapping reconciliation included in delivery.

services.name: README / repo documentation pack
services.scope: One repository. You provide repo link or code snapshot.
services.validation: All commands in README are executed against the repo before delivery where runnable.

services.name: Single-page HTML/CSS redesign
services.scope: One static page (landing, docs page, profile). You provide current HTML or content.
services.validation: W3C validator clean; renders at 360px and 1440px widths.

services.name: Static security review report (up to 1k LOC)
services.scope: Dependency audit + static checks + manual pattern review for one small repo or module. Not a penetration test.
services.validation: Every finding reproducible from the submitted code; no speculative claims.

services.name: Batch data cleanup & formatting
services.scope: Text/tabular normalization: dates, phone/address formats, casing, whitespace, dedup. Up to 50k rows.
services.validation: Rule-by-rule counts of changed cells; reversible via provided diff.
